function.name: personality_assessment_evaluate
function.description: Evaluate and categorize a user's personality type based on a given array of personality trait percentages. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

percentage.description: The percentage representation of the trait in the user's personality.

detailed_output.description: Determines whether the output should include a detailed explanation of the personality type. This is optional.

message.content: 抱歉，我無法直接為你朋友提供 MBTI（MBTI）類型，除非你能提供一些關於他/她性格特質的具體資訊。若你願意，可以把朋友在以下幾個人格特質上的百分比（例如外向/內向、感知/直覺、思考/情感、判斷/知覺等）告訴我，我就能使用評估工具來幫你推算出相對應的 MBTI 類型。若你不方便提供這些資料，也可以先讓朋友自行完成一份 MBTI 測驗，然後再把結果告訴我。謝謝！
message.reasoning: The user says: "請給我朋友的MTBI." They want the MBTI (I think they mean MBTI). They want the MBTI of their friend. But we don't have data about the friend. We cannot provide MBTI without assessment. According to policy, we must not provide MBTI without proper assessment. We can ask for more info or explain that we need data. So we should respond that we need more information or ask them to provide trait percentages. Also we can mention that we can't guess. So we should politely ask for trait percentages or ask them to fill out a questionnaire. Also we can mention that we can evaluate if they provide trait percentages. So we should respond accordingly.
